chap_01.title: The Cipher on the Tide
chap_01.summary: Silas Vance receives the stopped pocket watch at his gas-lit agency during an October gale.
chap_01.content:
The rain fell against the leaded panes of 14 High Quay Street with the persistence of a dying pulse.

Silas Vance adjusted the brass desk lamp, the wick sputtering as a draft slipped beneath the heavy oak door. Before him lay a couriers parcel—rough butcher paper, bound with tarred hemp string, smelling unmistakably of brine and dead kelp.

He slit the twine with his silver folding knife.

Inside rested an antique pocket watch. Its heavy silver casing had been blackened by sea salt, the crystal cracked diagonally from the Roman numeral nine to four. The hands were seized at precisely 3:17. When Silas pried the rear casing open with the tip of his thumbnail, no pendulum hummed. Instead, engraved into the balance cock was a single word, cut with precision: REVERIE.

Tucked behind the escapement was a folded strip of parchment, stiffened by seawater. It bore no signature—only six lines written in iron gall ink, and a wax seal stamped with the three-headed raven of House Blackwood.

If you value what remains of the harbor, Vance, do not let Alistair light the maritime lantern tonight.

Silas stood, reaching for his wool overcoat and the Webley revolver in the top drawer. Ravenscar had buried many things beneath its cold cliffs, but tonight, the tide was coughing them back up.

Every detail of the surroundings seemed etched with quiet menace. The damp sea air clung to the stone walls, condensing into slow, bead-like droplets that trailed downward like silent tears. In the distance, the foghorn sounded at deliberate four-minute intervals—a mournful iron groan that echoed across the jagged headland.

chap_02.title: The Shadows of Blackwood Manor
chap_02.summary: Silas confronts Lord Alistair Blackwood in his portrait gallery while inspecting the missing lady locked quarters.
chap_02.content:
Blackwood Manor stood upon the jagged headland like a vulture perched over a carcass.

Lord Alistair Blackwood received Silas in the grand conservatory, where dying orchids hung in humid iron cages. Alistair was a man constructed of sharp angles and nervous habit, his fingers perpetually fidgeting with a heavy gold signet ring.

My sister was hysterical, Vance. Prone to nighttime wanderings, Alistair said, pouring amber port into two cut-crystal glasses without offering one. She took a boat. A tragic accident of grief.

Hysterical women rarely mail stopped watches with coordinates to investigators four hours before they disappear, My Lord, Silas replied softly, producing the silver timepiece from his coat pocket.

Alistairs hand shook. A single droplet of dark wine spilled onto the marble floor.

Where did you get that? His voice dropped an octave, all veneer of aristocratic composure stripped clean. She kept that locked in the family reliquary. The key was buried with our father.

Silas watched the lords eyes dart toward the grand grandfather clock at the end of the gallery. For a split second, Silas noticed something strange: the clocks brass pendulum was not swinging, yet a rhythmic metallic clicking echoed from behind the mahogany wainscoting.

chap_03.title: The Whispering Archives
chap_03.summary: Silas consults archivist Clara Moreau to translate the occult sigils and discover the hidden sea vault.
chap_03.content:
The Municipal Archives smelled of vinegar, dust, and decaying leather.

Clara Moreau laid the parchment beneath a heavy brass magnifying lens, her spectacles reflecting the yellow glow of three tallow candles. Her finger traced the ravens crest, tracing down to the microscopic script hidden within the feather flourishes.

This is not Victorian cipher, Silas, Clara murmured, her voice breathless. It is fourteenth-century maritime code. The Order of the Iron Tide.

The smugglers?

Smugglers do not build underground vaults seventy fathoms into granite cliffs, she countered, sliding an ancient harbor survey across the scarred table. Look here. In 1842, the Blackwood family financed the construction of the north breakwater. On paper, it was to protect merchant vessels. But the excavation records show six hundred tons of stone were hauled out of the reef, not deposited.

She looked up at Silas, her eyes wide with dread.

Whatever was sealed beneath Ravenscar was never meant to be opened from the sea. It was meant to be unlocked from the manors cellar.

char_silas_vance.name: Silas Vance
char_silas_vance.backstory: Former naval surgeon turned private inquiry agent after an incident during the Crimean expedition. Settled in Ravenscar seven years ago, specializing in maritime insurance fraud.
char_silas_vance.physical_description: Tall, lean frame with broad shoulders; silvering dark hair, keen gray eyes, and a faint scar along his left jawline. Always wears an oilskin overcoat.

relationships.notes: Relies on her historical knowledge; unexpressed mutual affection.
Suspects Alistair is orchestrating his sisters disappearance.
Sent the pocket watch before vanishing.

char_silas_vance.motivations: Uncover the truth behind the Blackwood familys dark maritime pact before innocent dockworkers perish.
char_silas_vance.goals: Locate Lady Evelyn alive and decode the obsidian key.
char_silas_vance.fears: Drowning in enclosed underground water; repeating the medical catastrophe of his naval past.
char_silas_vance.secrets: Possesses a second matching watch given to him by an unknown officer during the Crimean war.
char_silas_vance.character_arc: Begins as a detached, cynical investigator haunted by a past naval catastrophe; progressively embraces personal vulnerability and risks everything to protect the truth and innocent lives.

char_clara_moreau.name: Clara Moreau
char_clara_moreau.backstory: Daughter of a French cartographer who died mysteriously during the harbor surveys. Took over the municipal archive ten years ago.
char_clara_moreau.physical_description: Dark auburn hair pinned into a practical chignon, round brass spectacles, ink-stained fingers, wears high-collared tweed waistcoats.

relationships.notes: Deep intellectual bond and mutual protective instinct.
Shared clandestine correspondence regarding occult cartography.

char_clara_moreau.motivations: Vindicate her fathers discredited maritime theories and save Evelyn.
char_clara_moreau.goals: Translate the complete Order of the Iron Tide codex.
char_clara_moreau.fears: The destruction of historical truth; fire in the archive.
char_clara_moreau.secrets: Stole an original harbor survey ledger from the town hall vaults five years ago.
char_clara_moreau.character_arc: Evolves from a quiet archival scholar into a decisive field ally, using forbidden historical secrets to stand against powerful conspirators.

char_alistair_blackwood.name: Lord Alistair Blackwood
char_alistair_blackwood.backstory: Current head of the Blackwood merchant dynasty. Succeeded his father three years ago under ambiguous circumstances.
char_alistair_blackwood.physical_description: Impeccably tailored morning coat, pale gaunt face, thinning blond hair, manicured mustache, nervous twitch in right hand.

relationships.notes: Views her as a dangerous threat to the familys financial empire.
Attempting to bribe and subtly threaten Silas off the investigation.

char_alistair_blackwood.motivations: Maintain the Blackwood estates solvency by fulfilling the ancestral blood covenant before the winter solstice.
char_alistair_blackwood.goals: Recover the obsidian key and seal the sea cavern.
char_alistair_blackwood.fears: Public ruin and whatever entity resides beneath the north breakwater.
char_alistair_blackwood.secrets: Drugged Evelyn on the night of her disappearance, though she subsequently escaped.
char_alistair_blackwood.character_arc: Transitions from an arrogant aristocrat in control to an increasingly desperate puppet trapped by ancestral debts and existential terror.

char_evelyn_blackwood.name: Lady Evelyn Blackwood
char_evelyn_blackwood.backstory: Educated abroad in botanical sciences. Discovered the occult ledgers locked in her late fathers safe upon returning to Ravenscar.
char_evelyn_blackwood.physical_description: Raven hair, striking violet eyes, pale aristocratic complexion; left behind a torn silk emerald gown in her bedroom.

relationships.notes: Specifically targeted Silas because of his spotless reputation.
Left hidden clues Clara alone could decipher.

char_evelyn_blackwood.motivations: Break the Blackwood curse and prevent the bell in the deep from chiming.
char_evelyn_blackwood.goals: Reach the subterranean sea chamber ahead of her brothers mercenaries.
char_evelyn_blackwood.fears: Succumbing to the hereditary madness of her family.
char_evelyn_blackwood.secrets: Is currently hiding in the abandoned salt cellar beneath the old smugglers pier.
char_evelyn_blackwood.character_arc: Shifts from a presumed helpless missing victim to the mastermind and catalyst of the resistance against the maritime occult order.

char_7eb057faf2.name: Julian Calder
char_7eb057faf2.backstory: Former forensic accountant for the maritime commission who uncovered systematic smuggling along the northern straits.
char_7eb057faf2.physical_description: Sharp hawk-like features, steel-framed spectacles, wears charcoal wool overcoats with reinforced inner pockets.
char_7eb057faf2.motivations: Expose the high-ranking syndicate responsible for his partner's suspicious death.
char_7eb057faf2.goals: Recover the missing double-entry manifests before the audit committee convenes.
char_7eb057faf2.fears: Being framed for the embezzlement he spent three years documenting.
char_7eb057faf2.secrets: Retains the private telegraph key capable of intercepting port communications.
char_7eb057faf2.character_arc: Determined to uncover the secrets buried within the estate before his own family's ties to the founders are exposed.

evt_01.title: Delivery of the Salt-Soaked Watch
evt_01.description: An unidentified harbor boy delivers a waterlogged package to Silas Vance inquiry office at 14 High Quay Street. The rear casing contains the cipher REVERIE.
evt_01.location: Silas Vance Office, 14 High Quay St
consequences: The Blackwood crest is tied to the crime

evt_02.title: Inspection of the Broken Bedroom
evt_02.description: Silas arrives at Blackwood Manor. Inside Lady Evelyn bedchamber, the French doors are shattered inward, and torn scraps of emerald silk are stuck on the iron balcony.
consequences: Confirms Evelyn did not leave willingly

evt_03.title: Alistairs Glass Spills
evt_03.description: During interrogation, Silas produces the pocket watch. Alistair experiences a visible panic attack and claims the key to that watch was buried with their father.
consequences: Alistair is confirmed hiding crucial knowledge of the heirloom

evt_04.title: Uncovering the Granite Breakwater Blueprint
evt_04.description: Clara Moreau pulls the 1842 harbor survey ledgers. Six hundred tons of stone were removed from the reef, constructing a hidden subterranean chamber under the sea bed.
consequences: Target coordinates established for the midnight expedition

evt_05.title: The Decoded Iron Tide Codex
evt_05.description: Clara identifies the secret iron gall inscription as fourteenth-century maritime script describing The Obsidian Key capable of releasing the subterranean lock.
consequences: Warns of severe seismic repercussions if the vault is opened at low tide

evt_06.title: Midnight Infiltration of the Smugglers Grotto
evt_06.description: Silas and Clara descend into the sea cave beneath the north lighthouse as the tide rises to their knees.
consequences: Direct encounter with Lord Alistairs armed henchmen

evt_07.title: Confrontation at the Submerged Altar
evt_07.description: Evelyn is discovered barricaded inside the tidal chamber with the obsidian key in hand.
consequences: The true nature of the family ancient bargain is laid bare

evt_4f4ba2632f.description: Crucial evidence was uncovered, fundamentally shifting the investigative direction.

mem_01.title: The Cipher Word REVERIE
mem_01.description: Engraved inside the balance cock of the salt-blackened pocket watch. Serves as the passphrase for the second lock in the Blackwood family reliquary.

mem_02.title: Stopped Time at 3:17
mem_02.description: The exact time the pocket watch was immersed in sea water. Matches the recorded peak of the spring low tide on October 14th.

mem_03.title: The Three-Headed Raven Seal
mem_03.description: The hereditary wax seal of House Blackwood, dating back to 1680. Used only on matters of succession or secret family trusts.

mem_04.title: 1842 Reef Excavation Secret
mem_04.description: Six hundred tons of granite were removed from the north breakwater under the guise of harbor repairs to carve out a submerged occult chamber.

mem_05.title: The Order of the Iron Tide
mem_05.description: A clandestine fraternity of Victorian industrialists and harbor masters who believe an ancient leviathan sleeps beneath the bay.

mem_06.title: Alistairs Gold Signet Ring
mem_06.description: Carries an internal compartment containing cyanide or powdered belladonna. Alistair turns it when under severe interrogation stress.

mem_07.title: Claras Stolen Harbor Ledger
mem_07.description: Clara holds an illegal copy of the original 1842 town surveyors journal, which her late father hid before his fatal boat accident.

mem_08.title: The Obsidian Key
mem_08.description: A non-metallic black stone key carved with spiraling tide markers. Opens the inner sanctum beneath the submerged altar.

issue_01.title: Pocket Watch Key Contradiction
issue_01.description: Contradiction regarding the custody and existence of the reliquary key for the Blackwood watch.
issue_01.previous_conflicting_info: Chapter 1: Silas effortlessly opens the watch outer casing with his thumbnail at his desk.
issue_01.current_conflicting_info: Chapter 2: Lord Alistair swears under oath that the watch cannot be opened without a key that was buried with his father.
issue_01.suggested_correction: Clarify that Silas only opened the outer watch casing, whereas the inner movement gear compartment requires the ancestral brass key.

issue_02.title: Weather & Wave Height Inconsistency
issue_02.description: Tidal timing discrepancy between Silas leaving his office and arriving at the Manor.
issue_02.previous_conflicting_info: Chapter 1: Silas notes the gale is blowing inland at low tide (3:17 AM).
issue_02.current_conflicting_info: Chapter 2: Lord Alistair describes his sister leaving by rowboat at 3:30 AM into raging 15-foot breaker waves that would have smashed any boat against the reef.
issue_02.suggested_correction: Have Silas point out this exact physical impossibility to Alistair during the conservatory confrontation to catch him in a deliberate lie.

issue_03.title: Lady Evelyn Dress Description
issue_03.description: Discrepancy in the color and fabric of Evelyn abandoned clothing.
issue_03.previous_conflicting_info: Chapter 2: Silas discovers torn scraps of emerald silk caught on the balcony railing.
issue_03.current_conflicting_info: Chapter 3: Clara recalls Evelyn wearing a dark wool traveling cape and sturdy boots on the afternoon before her vanishing.
issue_03.suggested_correction: Add a line explaining that the emerald silk was a decoy planted in the bedroom to suggest an abduction from bed.
